instruction:
Fix `packages/element/src/delta.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Undo does not clear arrowheadSize (FR-4). U21's test (packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx, typed 3 times, every attempt failed the same way) fails: "element locking > properties when elements selected > undoes and redoes arrowheadSize changes and copies/pastes arrowheadSize styles between arrows" -> AssertionError: expected 1.5 to be undefined, at `Keyboard.undo(); expect((h.elements[0] as any).arrowheadSize).toBeUndefined();` (and the same with h.app.actionManager.executeAction(undoAction)). Scenario: an arrow created with no arrowheadSize own property; actionChangeArrowheadSize sets 1.5 via newElementWith with CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY; undo leaves arrowheadSize at 1.5. Expected after undo: arrowheadSize === undefined and `"arrowheadSize" in element` === false; redo restores 1.5. The applyDirectly delete-undefined-keys loop added at the end of the element partial application only helps if the history delta records the key at all: make ElementsDelta / Delta.calculate (and its key-distinguishing helpers) record a key that is present on one side and absent on the other (absent -> undefined), so undo of an added arrowheadSize carries arrowheadSize: undefined and the application removes the key. Do not change behaviour for keys that are absent on both sides.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/element/src/delta.ts", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/element/src/delta.ts", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
